visual_anchor: First subgroup of the chart. P2 cell reading '01' over '(MODE SSB)' is one ruled box spanning the 14 rows from AGC FAST DELAY to RPTT SELECT; its two text lines sit level with P3 rows 07-08. The enclosing P1 cell '01 (RADIO SETTING)' is a single tall box running from the header rule down to the table's closing rule at the foot of the page, covering all six P2 subgroups on this page.

P2 cell '02' over '(MODE AM)' is a ruled box beginning at the rule immediately under MODE SSB row 14 (RPTT SELECT) and ending at the rule under row 15 (RPTT SELECT); label lines sit level with P3 rows 08-09. No vertical rule separates it from the P1 cell above or below, which continues unbroken as '01 (RADIO SETTING)'.

P2 cell '03' over '(MODE FM)' spans 16 rows, label level with P3 rows 08-09. This is the subgroup opposite which the P1 label '01' over '(RADIO SETTING)' is printed (level with MODE FM rows 11-12), confirming the P1 cell encloses it.
P2 cell '04' over '(MODE PSK/DATA)' spans 16 rows between the rule under MODE FM row 16 and the rule under RPTT SELECT; label level with P3 rows 08-09. Still inside the same unbroken P1 box.
P2 cell '05' over '(MODE RTTY)' spans 14 rows; label level with P3 rows 07-08. Bounded above by the rule under MODE PSK/DATA row 16 and below by the rule under SHIFT FREQUENCY.

Last subgroup on the page. P2 cell '06' over '(ENC/DEC PSK)' spans only 5 rows, label level with P3 rows 02-03. The rule under PSK TX LEVEL is the table's bottom border and closes the P1 cell '01 (RADIO SETTING)' as well; nothing but white space lies between it and the page's black footer bar.

First subgroup on the page, directly under the repeated 'Table 2 (MENU Chart)' / P1|P2|P3|Function|P4|Digits header rows. The P1 label '01' over '(RADIO SETTING)' is printed again in a fresh ruled box that is exactly 6 rows tall, matching the P2 box '07' over '(ENC/DEC RTTY)'; both labels sit level with P3 rows 03-04. A full-width rule under BAUDOT CODE closes both cells.

P1 cell '02' over '(CW SETTING)' opens at the rule under BAUDOT CODE and runs 31 rows to the rule under CW DECODE BW; its label sits level with MODE CW rows 16-17. Inside it the P2 cell '01' over '(MODE CW)' spans 17 rows with its label level with P3 rows 08-09. Row 12 (CW BK-IN DELAY) is a double-height ruled cell.

P2 cell '02' over '(KEYER)' spans 13 rows between the rule under CW INDICATOR and the rule under REPEAT INTERVAL; label level with P3 rows 06-07. The P1 column beside it shows no rule, confirming it is still inside the '02 (CW SETTING)' box.

Single-row subgroup. The P2 cell '03' over '(DECODE CW)' is a box exactly the height of the one ruled row, which is itself double-height so the two label lines fit. A rule immediately beneath it crosses both the P2 and the P1 columns, closing the '02 (CW SETTING)' box.

P1 cell '03' over '(OPERATION SETTING)' opens at the rule under CW DECODE BW and runs to the table's bottom border at the foot of the page; its label sits level with GENERAL rows 15-16. The P2 cell '01' over '(GENERAL)' spans 23 rows, label level with P3 rows 13-14; rows 22 (CS DIAL) and 23 (KEYBOARD LANGUAGE) are multi-line ruled cells.

Last subgroup on the page. P2 cell '02' over '(RX-DSP)' spans 5 rows, label level with P3 rows 02-03. The rule under IF NOTCH WIDTH is the table's bottom border and also closes the P1 cell; the remaining lower third of the page is blank.

First subgroup on the page, under the repeated header rows. The P1 label '03' over '(OPERATION SETTING)' is printed again in a fresh box that runs 34 rows down to the rule under MPVD STEPS PER REV.; its label sits level with TX AUDIO rows 16-17. The P2 cell '03' over '(TX AUDIO)' spans 20 rows with its label level with P3 rows 10-11; rows 06, 09, 15 and 18 are double-height ruled cells.

P2 cell '04' over '(TX GNRL)' spans 7 rows between the rule under P PRMTRC EQ3 BWTH and the rule under EMERGENCY FREQ TX; label level with P3 rows 03-04. The P1 column beside it carries no rule, so it remains inside the '03 (OPERATION SETTING)' box.
P2 cell '05' over '(TUNING)' spans 7 rows, label level with P3 rows 04-05. The rule under MPVD STEPS PER REV. crosses the P1 column as well, closing the '03 (OPERATION SETTING)' box.

P1 cell '04' over '(DISPLAY SETTING)' opens at the rule under MPVD STEPS PER REV. and runs 14 rows to the table's closing border under PIXEL; its label sits level with DISPLAY rows 07-08. The P2 cell '01' over '(DISPLAY)' spans 8 rows, label level with P3 rows 04-05; row 07 (MOUSE POINTER SPEED) is a double-height cell with the name wrapped onto two lines.
P2 cell '02' over '(SCOPE)' spans 4 rows between the rule under FREQ STYLE and the rule under 3DSS DISP SENSITIVITY; its two label lines sit level with P3 rows 01-02.

Final subgroup of the chart. P2 cell '03' over '(EXT-MONITOR)' is just 2 rows tall, the two label lines sitting one against each row. The rule under PIXEL is the table's bottom border, closing the P2 and P1 cells together; the lower half of the page is blank down to the black footer bar and folio 12.
